QUOTE: "**Short answer:** with the default `mbedtls_config.h`, the library starts no threads and takes no locks." and "Nothing inside mbedtls. There is no thread creation in the library."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that no threads are created by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main. It instead says the example "needs the threading layer enabled to be safe."
